title: 含两个电容的运放电路：结点法求相量
statement: 图示电路中运放为理想运放，接成电压跟随器（输出端直接接反相输入端）。V̇_s = 2∠0° V（有效值），ω = 1000 rad/s，R_1 = R_2 = 1 kΩ，C_1 = C_2 = 1 µF；C_1 从结点 m 接到输出端 o。
用结点电压法求输出电压 V_o 的有效值和相位、结点 m 的电压 V_m，以及 C_1 中的电流 I_C1（参考方向见图）。

questions.explain: 解出 V̇_o = −j1 V，|V̇_o| = 1 V（只有输入的一半）。

questions.ask: C_1 中电流的有效值 I_C1 = ?
questions.explain: İ_C1 = jωC_1(V̇_m − V̇_o) = j1 mS × (1 − j + j) V = j1 mA，有效值 1 mA，超前 V̇_s 90°。

hints: 跟随器：V_{−} = V_o，虚短 V_p = V_{+} = V_{−}，所以 V_p = V_o；虚断：结点 p 不向运放输入端流出电流。
结点 p 只有 R_2 和 C_2：(V̇_m − V̇_o)/R_2 = jωC_2·V̇_o，先用 V̇_o 表示 V̇_m。
结点 m：(V̇_s − V̇_m)/R_1 = (V̇_m − V̇_o)/R_2 + jωC_1(V̇_m − V̇_o)。注意 C_1 的另一端接的是输出 o，不是地。
solution: **1. 已知量。** 1/R = 1 mS，jωC = j1 mS（ωRC = 1）。跟随器 + 虚短：V̇_p = V̇_o。
**5. 验算（结点 m 的 KCL）。** 流入：(2 − 1 + j)/1k = 1 + j1 mA；流出：R_2 中 1 mA，C_1 中 j1 mA，合计 1 + j1 mA ✓。
这是一个二阶有源低通滤波器（Sallen–Key 型）；在 ω = 1/(RC) 处输出滞后 90°、幅值为输入的 1/2。

en.title: Op-amp circuit with two capacitors: phasors by nodal analysis
statement: The ideal op-amp is connected as a voltage follower (output tied directly to the inverting input). V̇_s = 2∠0° V (rms), ω = 1000 rad/s, R_1 = R_2 = 1 kΩ, C_1 = C_2 = 1 µF; C_1 goes from node m to the output o.
Use nodal analysis to find the rms value and phase of the output voltage V_o, the voltage V_m of node m, and the current I_C1 in C_1 (reference direction as drawn).

questions.explain: The solution is V̇_o = −j1 V, |V̇_o| = 1 V (half the input).
İ_C1 = jωC_1(V̇_m − V̇_o) = j1 mS × (1 − j + j) V = j1 mA: 1 mA rms, leading V̇_s by 90°.

hints: Follower: V_{−} = V_o, and the virtual short gives V_p = V_{+} = V_{−}, so V_p = V_o; the virtual open means no current leaves node p into the op-amp input.
Node p has only R_2 and C_2: (V̇_m − V̇_o)/R_2 = jωC_2·V̇_o; express V̇_m in terms of V̇_o first.
Node m: (V̇_s − V̇_m)/R_1 = (V̇_m − V̇_o)/R_2 + jωC_1(V̇_m − V̇_o). Note that the other end of C_1 is the output o, not ground.
solution: **1. Data.** 1/R = 1 mS, jωC = j1 mS (ωRC = 1). Follower + virtual short: V̇_p = V̇_o.
**2. Node p (virtual open).** (V̇_m − V̇_o)/R_2 = jωC_2·V̇_o → V̇_m = (1 + jωR_{2}C_{2})V̇_o = **(1 + j)V̇_o**.
**5. Check (KCL at m).** In: (2 − 1 + j)/1k = 1 + j1 mA; out: 1 mA in R_2 and j1 mA in C_1, total 1 + j1 mA ✓.
This is a second-order active low-pass filter (Sallen–Key type); at ω = 1/(RC) the output lags by 90° with half the input amplitude.
